title: UGC problem and solution
description: The PAS ad and the default when a brief names a pain but no format: open on the failure state with the product absent, agitate one consequence for at most five seconds, turn on a hard cut with the sound dropping out, demonstrate honestly, and land on a relief shot that rhymes with frame zero. Covers direction defaults, beat sheets with frame budgets at 15, 30 and 45 seconds and the turn frame for each, hook options, the honest-demo rules, the sound plan, and building matched failure and relief frames on Three.js.
summary: The PAS ad and the default: failure first with the product absent, one consequence, a hard turn by 7 s, an honest demo, a rhyming relief.

requires.why: The failure and relief beats are a matched pair of stills.
Bring the user's own footage in before trimming it.
The turn lands on a line, said flatly.
The audio drop at the turn is half of what sells it.
The failure and relief frames have to read as the same place.

route.deliverable: A 10–45 second vertical ad: the pain on screen, a hard turn, an honest demo, the relief
askFirst: What is the specific pain the viewer has right now?
What is the proof it works?

models.note: Prompt the failure and relief as a pair so framing and light match.
Tired, not performative, through the problem; a small lift on the turn.
The problem's own small sound, one resolving tone.
